text: Owner decision 2026-09-18: R must not be a dependency of any eyes4s workflow. The current template slice (docs/TEMPLATE_FITTING.md, io TemplateFitCsv, tools/template-fit/fit.R, tools/study-cli/TemplateFitCli.scala) requires running Rscript to fit coefficients and then importing them; that route is to be replaced by native least-squares fitting in eyes4s. R remains allowed only as an offline oracle that generates checked-in parity fixtures under tools/r-parity, never needed to run tests or workflows. The external-coefficient import path may stay only as optional interop, not as the documented workflow.
